target: acceptance 2 — a missing profile line is standard, silently
cmd: v=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" profile "$FIXTURES/profile/absent.md" 2>/dev/null); c=$?; e=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" profile "$FIXTURES/profile/absent.md" 2>&1 >/dev/null | wc -c | tr -d " "); printf '{"v":"%s","c":%s,"stderr_bytes":%s}' "$v" "$c" "$e"
